name: Bauerntarock
summary: Point-trick declarer-vs-defenders card game from Austria with Hearts as permanent trumps, played with a 36-card German pack.
rules_text: 3 players get 11 cards each plus 3 to the talon; with 4 players 8 each plus 4 to the talon. Deal and play clockwise. Bidding: clockwise one bid each: Pass, Hineinschauen (peep at talon) and Sumpern (hand game, no talon) with Sumpern higher. If all pass, dealer may re-deal on Schöneres call. Declarer taking talon picks it up and discards equal cards announcing readiness. Defenders who did not pass may double, declarer may redouble. Play: declarer leads. Must follow suit; if void must trump with Hearts; if void in both may slough. No need to win. Goal is majority of 120 card points: Daus 11, Ten 10, King 4, Ober 3, Unter 2, Spatzen 0. Trick order Daus > Ten > King > Ober > Unter > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 in all suits. 6 of Hearts is Spatz: -5 if lost to opponents, -10 if on last trick, +10 if last trick won with it. Doubles apply. Score = captured points + talon/discards +/- Spatz minus 60/120/240/480. First to 100 ends after finishing dealer rotation; highest total wins.
rating_reason: Point-trick tarock variant on 36-card pack, strategic.
